title: SKE Crystal Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Kiwi Passionfruit Guava flavour from SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid transports you to a tropical paradise with its blend of exotic fruits. Each vape delivers the tangy sweetness of kiwi, the rich essence of passionfruit, and the subtle notes of guava, creating a complex and refreshing fruit profile. Ideal for those who enjoy bright and bold fruit flavours, this e-liquid uses nicotine salts for a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine satisfaction, making it perfect for former smokers and those new to vaping. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides excellent flavour and vapour production, suitable for all types of mouth-to-lung devices. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
